_comment: PROTOCOL §7.4/§7.5 — the VOICE_* message layer. Every row is (type, payload) -> parsed or rejected, and both platforms' VoiceSignalCodec runs this same file, so a bound enforced on one platform and not the other is a laptop unit-test failure rather than something two phones discover on a ride. Generated by tools/generate_voice_signal_vectors.py — an independent third implementation of the spec. Edit the generator, never this file.
_invariant: No row may expect a malformed VOICE_* frame to end the control connection. §7.4: the framing was intact, so the frame is dropped and the connection survives. Every 'rejected' row is a drop, never a disconnect.
_test_values_only: Every SDP, candidate, fingerprint and voice_session_id here is fabricated. No real key, address, exporter output or pairing code appears in protocol/vectors/.
